name: MOSAIC
aliases: MOdified urinary conduit to lower Strictures After radIcal Cystectomy
question: Does retrosigmoid transposition of an intracorporeal ileal conduit reduce left ureteroenteric strictures after robot-assisted radical cystectomy?

design.population: Patients with bladder cancer scheduled for robot-assisted radical cystectomy and intracorporeal ileal conduit at five Danish cystectomy centers.
design.description: Multicenter, open-label randomized superiority surgical trial
design.locator: Brandt 2025, Patients and Methods, Study Design and Results; Brandt 2024, sections 2.1 and 3

verdictNote: Left-sided stricture reduction was not demonstrated; control incidence was below the power assumption.
takeaway: MOSAIC randomized patients scheduled for robot-assisted cystectomy to retrosigmoid or conventional intracorporeal ileal conduit; left ureteroenteric strictures occurred in 6/148 (4.1%) versus 10/149 (6.7%) by two years, without a statistically significant reduction.

reports.label: Feasibility and 90-day complications
reports.citation: Brandt SB, Körner SK, Milling RV, et al. "DaBlaCa-16: Retrosigmoid Versus Conventional Ileal Conduit in Robot-assisted Radical Cystectomy, the MOSAIC Randomized Controlled Trial—Feasibility and 90-day Postoperative Complications." *Eur Urol Open Sci.* 2024;60:8-14. doi:10.1016/j.euros.2023.12.007

harms.label: Clavien-Dindo grade III or higher complication within 90 days
harms.note: Table P=0.15; the article's prose instead gives P=0.17 and an RR inconsistent with these counts.

harms.label: Ureteroenteric anastomotic leak within 90 days
harms.locator: Brandt 2024, Table 3, anastomotic leak from ureter

delivery.label: Early surgical analysis population
delivery.value: 298 patients underwent cystectomy and entered the 90-day analysis: 148 assigned retrosigmoid conduit and 150 assigned conventional conduit.

delivery.label: Conduit construction

values.exp: Approximately 25 cm of ileum; oral conduit end passed behind sigmoid; left ureter anastomosed on left side
values.ctl: Approximately 15 cm of ileum; left ureter passed behind sigmoid to right-sided conduit

delivery.note: Separate spatulated, stented end-to-side ureteral anastomoses used running 4-0 absorbable monofilament sutures in both arms.

delivery.label: Resected left ureter length
delivery.note: P<0.001; operated population n=148 versus n=150.

delivery.label: Operative time
delivery.note: P=0.73; operated population n=148 versus n=150.

delivery.label: Allocated conduit received
delivery.note: Among experimental patients, 135 received the allocated robotic procedure and 2 received the allocated conduit during open surgery.

reports.label: Two-year left ureteroenteric stricture endpoint
reports.citation: Brandt SB, Körner SK, Milling RV, et al. "Ureteroenteric strictures following retrosigmoid vs. conventional ileal conduit - The MOSAIC study (The DaBlaCa-16 study)." *BJU Int.* 2025;136(5):858-865. doi:10.1111/bju.16894
reports.followUp: Median 755 days (IQR 710–785) in the full-text Results; abstract states 754 days
reports.followUpLocator: Brandt 2025, Results, first paragraph; PubMed abstract, Results

results.endpoint: Left ureteroenteric stricture within two years
results.measure: Patients with left ureteroenteric stricture by two years after cystectomy
results.note: The trial was powered for a 15% control versus 5% intervention incidence at two-sided alpha 0.05; table and abstract give P=0.31, while Results prose gives P=0.32.
results.locator: Brandt 2025, Table 2, left-sided UES; Power Calculation; PubMed abstract, Results

results.endpoint: Any ureteroenteric stricture within two years
results.measure: Patients with left- or right-sided ureteroenteric stricture by two years
results.note: Includes one patient with bilateral stricture; no P value is stated for the patient-level overall rate.

harms.note: P=0.89; defined by laboratory deficiency or cobalamin treatment.
